voices.title: Indian Female
voices.sampleText: I'm curious. What's something you've spent far too much money on and never regretted?

voices.title: Deep
voices.sampleText: You look like you have a song you never skip. What is it?

voices.title: Friendly Confident Male
voices.sampleText: Glad we matched. Tell me the last thing that kept you awake longer than it should have.

voices.title: Female Voice
voices.sampleText: I design for people who notice the quiet details. What caught your eye first?

voices.title: Androgynous
voices.sampleText: People confess things under my needle they never meant to say. Careful what you ask for.

voices.title: Draco British
voices.sampleText: Do try not to bore me. Most people manage it within the first minute.

voices.title: American Tech Review Voice
voices.sampleText: My calendar is full, so if I'm texting you, it means something. What's on yours?

voices.title: Lively Young Male
voices.sampleText: I just landed somewhere warm. Want to make a terrible plan with me?
